msg: I thought that there may have been a pattern to the point rewards from collecting the mushrooms in the forest. The amount of points seemed to ebb and flow; change in a regular and repeated way from high to low, low to high, high to low, like moving back and forth from either side of a scale of 0 to 9 points. I think if you score 4 or 5 points try testing that out by selecting the opposite gnome on the gnome selection screen.
